profile.name: Siddharth Pandey
profile.title: Lead Software Engineer
profile.summary: Full-stack engineer with 13+ years building and leading production systems across logistics, fintech, and e-commerce — from React and Node.js applications to cloud infrastructure and AI-powered workflows. Shipped RAG-based investigation pipelines, published MCP tooling on npm, and automated deployments with Terraform and AWS CDK. Grows teams through hiring, mentoring, and platform standards.

experience.title: Lead Software Engineer
experience.domain: Workforce automation SaaS · fully serverless on AWS Lambda
bullets: Architected an Insights Agent platform on AWS Lambda using the OpenAI and Anthropic TypeScript SDKs — orchestrates operational data APIs, maintains account-level context caches, and answers natural-language questions about fleet and order operations, cutting mean investigation time for support teams.

Built a single-order investigation agent that correlates data across services, applies decision logic to surface order-state anomalies, and generates the three most relevant follow-up questions inside a purpose-built chat interface.

Owned frontend architecture for a multi-tenant platform; modernised legacy React systems into a modular microfrontend architecture that enabled independent team deployments and removed cross-team coupling.
Led the infrastructure migration from MapTiler to Amazon Location Services with Terraform, cutting platform mapping cost by ~40% with zero end-user disruption.

Raised Lighthouse from ~23 → ~75 through module-boundary restructuring and code-splitting, and reduced map-heavy page load from ~3s → ~500ms by isolating real-time workflows into lightweight Svelte micro-applications.
Established org-wide platform standards: a shared component library documented in Storybook, Zustand and TanStack Query conventions, GraphQL schema simplification, and automated CI/CD quality gates.
Worked directly with enterprise customers through technical support channels to diagnose production issues and shape product workflows.

experience.title: Associate Technical Architect
bullets: Designed the company-wide microfrontend architecture on Single-SPA across Order Management, Inventory, Promotions, Customer Management, and RBAC — enabling independent deployment per domain.
Led the migration from a monolithic Magento frontend to a distributed microfrontend ecosystem in ~6 months with zero downtime.
Built and owned GraphQL/AppSync and Node.js services for authentication, authorisation, and core operational workflows.
Established the shared component library and design system, and shipped multilingual (English/Vietnamese) PWA and Ionic React applications for Southeast Asian markets.
Grew frontend engineering from solo execution to a distributed team through hiring, onboarding, and structured mentoring.

experience.title: Software Development Engineer III — Frontend
bullets: Built an internal landing-page management system (Angular, Node.js, Fastify, MongoDB) that let marketing publish localised vernacular campaigns without an engineering release; Lighthouse ~44 → ~98 and load time ~6s → ~300ms.
Lifted landing-page conversion ~7% → ~22% with localised, A/B-tested infrastructure supporting 100+ multilingual variants.
Developed a Puppeteer HTML-to-PDF pipeline for loan and legal documentation, replacing a manual workflow across thousands of monthly transactions.
Shipped an Angular customer-onboarding dashboard that improved onboarding efficiency ~44% and brought first-interaction latency to ~600ms.
Mentored junior engineers and partnered with product and business teams on experimentation and growth initiatives.

experience.title: Senior Software Developer
experience.domain: Product engineering services · PeopleHum HR platform
bullets: Architected the PeopleHum HR platform from greenfield — component architecture plus real-time notification and auth systems on Node.js, MongoDB, Redis, and Socket.io — holding Lighthouse above 90 across products.
Managed a team of ~5 engineers delivering HR workflows, engagement systems, and enterprise merchant tooling.
Recognised in internal hackathons for rapid prototyping and engineering innovation.

experience.title: Software Development Engineer
bullets: Built hybrid mobile applications with AngularJS, Ionic, and Cordova for a residential community engagement platform, contributing to early hybrid-mobile adoption at scale.
Developed backend-integrated features with PHP (Zend), MySQL, and JavaScript, and drove mobile usability and performance improvements.

education.title: Bachelor of Engineering — Information Technology
education.detail: Final-year project: E-Panorama, a web-based virtual tour application. Organised technical fests and robotics competitions alongside coursework.
